commits.message:
Watch kibana spec changes impl (#2325)

* feat: add kibana-spec-impact deterministic helper

Implement inventory from provider registrations, kbapi surface diff,
kibanaoapi-based symbol matching, repo-memory fingerprints, and JSON
impact reports with tests.

Made-with: Cursor

* ci: add Kibana spec-impact gh-aw workflow and gate tests

Register workflow in manifest, add repo-memory seed, pre-activation gate
script with TF_ELASTICSTACK_INCLUDE_EXPERIMENTAL for inventory parity.

Made-with: Cursor

* ci: prefer gh-aw repo-memory path for kibana-spec-impact gate

Made-with: Cursor

* fix(kibana-spec-impact): issued-only fingerprints and baseline advance

Split fingerprint recording from baseline advancement; memory-record-from-report
now takes optional --issued (entity names) so capped entities are not suppressed.
Always advance last_analyzed_target_sha after a completed run.

Add impactEntryForEntity helper and tests for matching, partial issuance, and
kbapi symbol removal diffs.

Made-with: Cursor

* fix(kibana-spec-impact): default SDK Kibana entities to internal/kibana pkg

Avoid inventory failure when new SDK Kibana resources are added before an
explicit mapping exists.

Made-with: Cursor

* docs: align kibana-spec-impact workflow and design with cap/baseline

Document --issued JSON for actual issues, mandatory baseline advance after runs,
and resolve design open questions (baseline fallback, schedule, transform V1).

Made-with: Cursor

* fix(kibana-spec-impact): git kbapi lifecycle, root scan, and --issued contract

- Treat missing kibana.gen.go at either revision as empty surface (no report failure)
- Root internal/kibana entities without prefix mappings scan the full package dir
- Require --issued when high_confidence_impacts non-empty (explicit [] allowed)
- Add tests: git fixture, matching/index fixtures, inventory scan, validation

Made-with: Cursor

* docs(ci): spec, workflow, and Makefile for kibana-spec-impact hardening

- Delta spec: cap/issued/baseline, kbapi lifecycle, root scan, --issued contract
- workflow-test runs go test on scripts/kibana-spec-impact
- Regenerated kibana-spec-impact.md (issued file always written)

Made-with: Cursor

* test(kibana-spec-impact): smoke discoverKibanaEntities and table sdkKibanaPkgPath

Made-with: Cursor

* fix(kibana-spec-impact): satisfy lint checks

Normalize the helper package headers and simplify a few signatures so the new Kibana spec-impact tooling passes the repository lint target locally.

Made-with: Cursor

* Weekly

* chore(openspec): archive kibana-spec-impact-workflow via verify-openspec

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 4.6 <noreply@anthropic.com>

* ci: trigger checks

* fix(kibana-spec-impact): error shadowing and nil map panic

- kbapi_diff.go: use `err =` not `err :=` in gitShowPathOrMissing so the
  named return captures the actual git exit error on the fallthrough path.
- memory.go: initialize ReportedFingerprints map in memoryAddFingerprint
  before writing, guarding against zero-value Memory or JSON missing the key.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Sonnet 4.6 <noreply@anthropic.com>

* fix(kibana-spec-impact): deterministic ordering for paths and entities

- report.go: sort.Strings(paths) in diffTransformSchemaPaths before returning
  so output is independent of git diff --name-only emission order.
- inventory.go: sort.Slice(out) in discoverKibanaEntities by Type then Name
  before returning, guarding against nondeterministic SDK map iteration order.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Sonnet 4.6 <noreply@anthropic.com>

* ci(kibana-spec-impact): add compiled workflow lock file

Generate .github/workflows/kibana-spec-impact.lock.yml via `gh aw compile`
to match the convention of other gh-aw workflows in this repo. The only new
restricted secret introduced is CLAUDE_LITELLM_PROXY_API_KEY, which is the
intentional Claude API proxy key used by the workflow agent step (already
present in the workflow.md.tmpl source).

Co-Authored-By: Claude Sonnet 4.6 <noreply@anthropic.com>

* perf(kibana-spec-impact): pre-index kibanaoapi content in buildKibanaOAPIIndex

matchHighConfidence previously called filesContainingSymbolInDir once per
changed symbol, causing O(symbols × files) disk reads. Now buildKibanaOAPIIndex
pre-loads each file's content into kibanaoapiIndex.fileContent alongside the
existing funcFile map; matchHighConfidence uses the in-memory map instead.

- Remove filesContainingSymbolInDir (no longer needed).
- Drop the now-unused repoRoot parameter from matchHighConfidence signature.
- Update call sites in report.go and index_match_test.go.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Sonnet 4.6 <noreply@anthropic.com>

* style: gofmt index.go

@@ -0,0 +1,211 @@
+---
+# This file is generated by `scripts/compile-workflow-sources/main.go` from `.github/workflows-src/kibana-spec-impact/workflow.md.tmpl`. Do not edit directly.
+name: Kibana spec impact
+description: >-
+  Detects Kibana OpenAPI / generated kbapi changes, maps deterministic impacts to Terraform
+  entities, and opens focused follow-up issues using hybrid agent summarization.
+on:
+  workflow_dispatch:
+  schedule:
+    - cron: weekly on monday
+  push:
+    branches:
+      - main
+    paths:
+      - 'generated/kbapi/**'
+      - 'internal/clients/kibanaoapi/**'
+  steps:
+    - name: Setup Go
+      uses: actions/setup-go@v6
+      with:
+        go-version-file: go.mod
+        cache: false
+    - name: Compute kibana spec impact
+      id: compute_kibana_spec_impact
+      uses: actions/github-script@v8
+      with:
+        github-token: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}
+        script: |
+          const ISSUE_CAP = 5;
+          
+          /**
+           * Derives workflow gate outputs from a deterministic kibana-spec-impact report object.
+           * @param {object} report - Parsed JSON from `go run ./scripts/kibana-spec-impact report`.
+           * @returns {{ shouldRun: boolean, issueCap: number, kbapiChanged: boolean, transformHints: boolean, highConfidenceCount: number, gate_reason: string }}
+           */
+          function kibanaSpecImpactGate(report) {
+            const kbapiChanged = (report.changed_kbapi_symbols || []).length > 0;
+            const transformHints = (report.transform_schema_hints || []).length > 0;
+            const hi = report.high_confidence_impacts || [];
+            const shouldRun = kbapiChanged || transformHints;
+            const issueCap = Math.min(ISSUE_CAP, hi.length);
+            const gateReason = `kbapi_changed=${kbapiChanged} transform_hints=${transformHints} high_confidence=${hi.length}`;
+            return {
+              shouldRun,
+              issueCap,
+              kbapiChanged,
+              transformHints,
+              highConfidenceCount: hi.length,
+              gate_reason: gateReason,
+            };
+          }
+          
+          if (typeof module !== 'undefined') {
+            module.exports = { ISSUE_CAP, kibanaSpecImpactGate };
+          }
+          
+          const { execFileSync } = require('child_process');
+          const fs = require('fs');
+          const path = require('path');
+          
+          const ws = process.env.GITHUB_WORKSPACE;
+          const sha = process.env.GITHUB_SHA || 'HEAD';
+          
+          const defaultMem = '/tmp/gh-aw/repo-memory/kibana-spec-impact/memory/kibana-spec-impact/kibana-spec-impact.json';
+          let mem = process.env.KIBANA_SPEC_IMPACT_MEMORY;
+          if (!mem && fs.existsSync(defaultMem)) {
+            mem = defaultMem;
+          } else if (!mem) {
+            mem = path.join(process.env.RUNNER_TEMP, 'kibana-spec-impact-memory.json');
+          }
+          
+          const goEnv = {
+            ...process.env,
+            TF_ELASTICSTACK_INCLUDE_EXPERIMENTAL: 'true',
+          };
+          
+          if (!fs.existsSync(mem)) {
+            execFileSync('go', ['run', './scripts/kibana-spec-impact', 'memory-bootstrap', '--memory', mem], {
+              cwd: ws,
+              env: goEnv,
+              stdio: 'inherit',
+            });
+          }
+          
+          const reportJson = execFileSync(
+            'go',
+            ['run', './scripts/kibana-spec-impact', 'report', '--repo', '.', '--memory', mem, '--target', sha],
+            { cwd: ws, encoding: 'utf8', env: goEnv },
+          );
+          
+          const r = JSON.parse(reportJson);
+          const g = kibanaSpecImpactGate(r);
+          
+          core.setOutput('should_run', g.shouldRun ? 'true' : 'false');
+          core.setOutput('issue_cap', String(g.issueCap));
+          core.setOutput('high_confidence_count', String(g.highConfidenceCount));
+          core.setOutput('gate_reason', g.gate_reason);
+          
+          fs.writeFileSync(path.join(ws, 'kibana-spec-impact-report.json'), JSON.stringify(r, null, 2) + '\n');
+          core.info(`kibana-spec-impact gate: ${g.gate_reason}`);
+          
+engine:
+  id: claude
+  model: "llm-gateway/gpt-5.4"
+  env:
+    ANTHROPIC_BASE_URL: "https://elastic.litellm-prod.ai/"
+    ANTHROPIC_API_KEY: ${{ secrets.CLAUDE_LITELLM_PROXY_API_KEY }}
+permissions:
+  contents: read
+  issues: read
+  pull-requests: read
+  actions: read
+tools:
+  timeout: 300
+  repo-memory:
+    - id: kibana-spec-impact
+      file-glob: ["memory/kibana-spec-impact/kibana-spec-impact.json"]
+      create-orphan: true
+      max-file-size: 524288
+      max-patch-size: 102400
+safe-outputs:
+  create-issue:
+    title-prefix: "[kibana-spec-impact] "
+    labels: [kibana, generated-clients, terraform-provider]
+    max: 5
+  noop:
+    max: 1
+    report-as-issue: false
+network:
+  allowed: [defaults, node, go, elastic.litellm-prod.ai]
+checkout:
+  fetch-depth: 0
+if: >-
+  needs.pre_activation.outputs.should_run == 'true'
+steps:
+  - name: Setup Go
+    uses: actions/setup-go@v6
+    with:
+      go-version-file: go.mod
+      cache: false
+  - name: Export Go paths for AWF chroot mode
+    run: |
+      echo "GOROOT=$(go env GOROOT)" >> "$GITHUB_ENV"
+      echo "GOPATH=$(go env GOPATH)" >> "$GITHUB_ENV"
+      echo "GOMODCACHE=$(go env GOMODCACHE)" >> "$GITHUB_ENV"
+  - name: Setup Node.js
+    uses: actions/setup-node@v6
+    with:
+      node-version-file: package.json
+  - name: Setup repository dependencies
+    run: make setup
+jobs:
+  pre_activation:
+    outputs:
+      should_run: ${{ steps.compute_kibana_spec_impact.outputs.should_run }}
+      issue_cap: ${{ steps.compute_kibana_spec_impact.outputs.issue_cap }}
+      high_confidence_count: ${{ steps.compute_kibana_spec_impact.outputs.high_confidence_count }}
+      gate_reason: ${{ steps.compute_kibana_spec_impact.outputs.gate_reason }}
+---
+
+# Kibana spec-impact worker
+
+You summarize **deterministic** Kibana client change evidence into at most one GitHub issue per impacted Terraform entity. The repository already computed the impact report in pre-activation; treat that JSON as the source of truth.
+
+## Pre-activation context
+
+Do **not** re-derive entity lists or kbapi diffs from scratch unless reproducing a bug. Use only:
+
+- **Should run**: `${{ needs.pre_activation.outputs.should_run }}` (this job runs only when `true`).
+- **Issue cap**: `${{ needs.pre_activation.outputs.issue_cap }}` — maximum new issues with `create-issue` this run (high-confidence entities only).
+- **High-confidence entities (count)**: `${{ needs.pre_activation.outputs.high_confidence_count }}`
+- **Gate reason**: ${{ needs.pre_activation.outputs.gate_reason }}
+
+## Deterministic report
+
+Read `kibana-spec-impact-report.json` at the repository root (written by pre-activation). It contains:
+
+- `baseline_sha` / `target_sha`
+- `changed_kbapi_symbols`
+- `transform_schema_hints` (lower-confidence; do **not** open issues from hints alone)
+- `high_confidence_impacts` — only these are eligible for new issues in V1
+- `suppressed_duplicates` — already recorded; never recreate the same fingerprint
+
+## Execution
+
+1. Open and parse `kibana-spec-impact-report.json`.
+2. For each entry in `high_confidence_impacts` **up to the issue cap**, create **one** issue per entity using `create-issue`. Title should include the Terraform entity name. Body must include:
+   - Entity type and name, and implementation `pkg_path`.
+   - Matched symbols / evidence from `matched_symbols`.
+   - A concise note on likely provider follow-up (new schema fields, widened enums, new API capabilities) inferred from symbols and local code context.
+3. If `high_confidence_impacts` is empty but `transform_schema_hints` is non-empty, call `noop` explaining that only transform-layer hints were present (no high-confidence kbapi entity mapping).
+4. If there is nothing actionable, call `noop` with a short reason.
+5. Always write `kibana-spec-impact-issued.json` before persisting memory:
+   - If `high_confidence_impacts` is **non-empty**: write a JSON array of Terraform `entity_name` values for which you **actually created** an issue this run (≤ issue cap). If you created **zero** issues despite impacts (for example a deliberate policy skip), write `[]` — the helper **requires** this file in that case so baseline advancement is never accidental.
+   - If `high_confidence_impacts` is **empty**: write `[]` (the `--issued` flag is then optional on the helper, but writing the file keeps the flow uniform).
+6. Persist repo memory by running (this **always** advances the analyzed baseline to `target_sha`; dedupe fingerprints are recorded **only** for entity names listed in `--issued`, so capped entities stay eligible next run):
+   ```
+   go run ./scripts/kibana-spec-impact memory-record-from-report \
+     --memory /tmp/gh-aw/repo-memory/kibana-spec-impact/memory/kibana-spec-impact/kibana-spec-impact.json \
+     --report kibana-spec-impact-report.json \
+     --issued kibana-spec-impact-issued.json
+   ```
+   Use the repo-memory path configured for this workflow if it differs in your environment. Run this after `noop` as well so successful analysis still advances the baseline when no new issues are created.
+
+## Guardrails
+
+- Never invent impacted entities; only use `high_confidence_impacts` for issue creation.
+- Do not open issues for `transform_schema_hints` alone in V1 (mention them in the body only when a high-confidence issue exists for context).
+- Do not exceed the issue cap. If fewer slots than entities, prioritize alphabetically by `entity_name` unless a maintainer instruction overrides.
+- Weak or broad matches are already filtered out by the helper; do not reopen suppressed fingerprints.
+- Only list entities in `kibana-spec-impact-issued.json` when you created their issue; the helper rejects `--issued` names that are not present in `high_confidence_impacts`. Capped eligible entities must be omitted so dedupe state never records them (avoids suppressing never-filed entities).

feat(gh-aw): extract shared setup-dev component from 9 agentic workflow templates (#3076)

* feat(gh-aw): add shared setup-dev.yml workflow component

Creates .github/workflows/shared/setup-dev.yml as a reusable GH-AW
import that unconditionally installs Go, Terraform CLI, Node.js, exports
chroot paths (GOROOT, GOPATH, GOMODCACHE, TERRAFORM_BIN), and runs
make setup. Has no on: field so it is never compiled as a standalone
workflow.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Sonnet 4.6 <noreply@anthropic.com>

* feat(gh-aw): add imports and remove duplicated setup steps from 9 templates

Adds imports: [shared/setup-dev.yml] to the frontmatter of all 9 agentic
workflow templates and deletes the agent-phase setup steps that the shared
component now covers (Setup Go, Export Go paths, Setup Terraform, Setup
Node.js, make setup). Also removes non-functional Elastic Stack scaffolding
(make docker-fleet, set-kibana-password, create-es-api-key, setup-kibana-fleet,
docker compose logs) from code-factory-issue and reproducer-factory-issue.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Sonnet 4.6 <noreply@anthropic.com>

* fix(gh-aw): rename shared component to .md and update all imports

Rename shared/setup-dev.yml to shared/setup-dev.md with GH-AW
frontmatter format (the gh-aw compiler requires .md for import files,
not .yml). Update all 9 workflow templates to reference the .md file.
Regenerate all compiled .md and .lock.yml files with make workflow-generate
and gh aw compile --approve (approving the new hashicorp/setup-terraform
action newly injected via the shared import into workflows that previously
did not include it).

Co-Authored-By: Claude Sonnet 4.6 <noreply@anthropic.com>

* test(gh-aw): update workflow tests to verify setup steps in lock files

After shared setup-dev.md import, setup steps no longer appear in
compiled .md files — they are inlined into .lock.yml only. Update
openspec-verify-label, schema-coverage-rotation-bootstrap, and
change-factory-issue test files to assert step presence in lockSource()
and import declaration in workflowSource().

Co-Authored-By: Claude Sonnet 4.6 <noreply@anthropic.com>

* chore(openspec): mark gh-aw-shared-setup-dev tasks complete

* fix(gh-aw): update reproducer-factory-issue prompt for inaccessible stack

The Elastic Stack setup steps were removed from the agent phase (AWF
network policy blocks access from chroot anyway). Update the agent
prompt to match: acknowledge the stack is not reachable, route outcomes
by static analysis rather than live test execution, matching the
treatment already applied to code-factory-issue.

* docs(openspec): update gh-aw-shared-setup-dev artifacts to use .md extension

* fix(gh-aw): address Copilot review feedback on reproducer prompt and setup-dev guard

- Update reproducer-factory-issue prompt: clarify the Elastic Stack is NOT
  provisioned (all provisioning steps were removed); remove the stale
  acceptance-test invocation block that referenced a live stack
